jobs.occupation: NBE DMPK Lead (all genders), limited for 2 years (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.Your Role:At the intersection of scientific innovation and patient impact, this role places you at the heart of next-generation biotherapeutic development. As the NBE DMPK Lead, you will serve as the authoritative scientific expert for drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics across a portfolio of novel biological entities — including ADCs, AOCs, and multispecific biologics. You will define the DMPK strategy for each molecule, integrating PK, immunogenicity, and bioanalytical approaches to de-risk clinical development and drive health authority submissions. Applying Modeling and Simulation, you will generate data-driven insights to inform molecular design and translate preclinical findings into human dose predictions. Embedded in cross-functional project teams, you will guide peers and senior stakeholders — shaping the scientific direction of your projects.This position is limited for two years.Who You Are:- You hold a degree or equivalent qualification in Pharmacokinetics, Pharmaceutical or Biotechnological Sciences, Biomedical or Chemical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related biological or chemical discipline; a doctoral degree with relevant industry experience is typical for this level.- You bring substantial professional experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with deep expertise in PK/PD concepts across drug discovery and development — including translational sciences and regulatory requirements for biotherapeutics such as ADCs, AOCs, and multispecific biologics.- You have hands-on experience with quantitative modeling approaches, including M&S tools, population PK software, QSP platforms, or programming environments such as Python or R; experience with AI/ML applications in drug development is a strong advantage.- You possess a solid understanding of adjacent disciplines — including pharmacology, toxicology, nonclinical safety, drug design, and bioanalytics — and can integrate insights across these areas to guide biotherapeutic engineering and optimization.- You communicate complex scientific concepts clearly and confidently to diverse audiences, including cross-functional project teams and senior stakeholders, and are comfortable influencing decisions without direct authority.- You are fluent in written and spoken English; proficiency in German or Italian is an advantage.- You bring strong organizational skills, intercultural awareness, and the ability to manage multiple project commitments with a high degree of autonomy.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description: Research Associate (m/f/d), EG 14 TV-H, fixed-term, full-time (currently 40 hours per week)Application deadline:20.11.2026Date of hire:01.01.2027vacancy number:39545The post is initially limited until 31 December 2028 as part of the ‘DyNaMo’ project, in accordance with its duration (academic qualification position pursuant to § 2 WissZeitVG).  An extension of the employment is planned. The opportunity to obtain a habilitation degree is given.The Intelligent Embedded Systems (IES) group conducts research in the area of fundamentals and applications of methods in data analysis, machine learning (e.g. deep learning, active learning) and artificial intelligence. In the focus of basic research are, for example, self-learning and self-organizing systems, methods of collaborative and active learning, methods of transfer learning, and techniques for real-time analysis of time series. Applied research focuses on the fields of energy systems, automotive (autonomous driving) and experimental physics/materials. The IES group currently employs around 20 researchers in the above areas.Your tasks:- Methods for perceiving cyclists’ behaviour by using machine learning techniques (in particular deep learning approaches) based on data from vehicle sensors (e.g. camera and LiDAR data).- Cross-labelling approaches for the highly automated annotation of cyclists’ behaviour data, i.e. transferring ‘labels’ from, for example, camera data to LiDAR data.- Methods for integrating information from models trained on different data modalities and evaluating the resulting information gain.- Planning and conducting measurement campaigns in the form of laboratory experiments as well as field experiments.- Research within the DyNaMo project.- Contributing to the group’s general tasks.Requirements:- A PhD and a completed university degree in Computer Science or a closely related field- Excellent knowledge in perception and computer vision.- Very good fundamental knowledge in machine learning and data analysis.- A successful academic career with high-impact publications in the relevant fields.- Experience in external fundraising (e.g. LOEWE, BMFTR, DFG).- Experience in programming, particularly in Python, but also in other programming languages.- Good knowledge of AI tools, e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Pandas, OpenCV and NumPy.- A structured approach to work that passion for scientific research.- Very good written and spoken German and English (at least B2 level in each).- A driving licence valid in Germany for passenger cars.The following conditions are advantageous- Experience in organisation and coordination (e.g. project management, team leadership).- Experience in supervising PhD students, e.g. when they write publications.As a member of staff in
